description_en: Writes or updates the semantic element content of a context model in batches
description_zh: 批量写入或更新上下文模型的语义元素内容
name: UpsertContextModel

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the context model to which elements are written. This value is obtained from the request path /context-models/{name}/upsert and must be the name of an existing model created under the current account. Only uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-) are supported. If the model does not exist, a 404 error is returned
parameters.help_zh: 待写入元素的上下文模型标识，取自请求路径 /context-models/{name}/upsert，须为当前账号下已创建的模型名；仅支持大小写字母、数字、下划线（_）与短横线（-）。模型不存在时返回 404
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The list of elements to be added or updated. Elements with the exact same type, domain, and name are replaced entirely rather than merged field by field. This operation only writes elements and does not delete any existing elements
parameters.help_zh: 要新增或更新的元素列表。类型、域、名称完全相同的元素会被整条替换，而不是逐字段合并；本接口只写入，不会删除任何元素
parameters.name: elements

schema.description_en: The response body. The result of the element write operation
schema.description_zh: 响应体。本次元素写入的结果

status.description_en: The status of the call result. If the write operation is successful, success is returned. A single model can contain up to 50,000 elements, and a single request can include up to 2,000 elements. If the limit is exceeded, no elements are written in the current request
status.description_zh: 调用结果状态。写入成功时固定返回 success。单个模型最多 50000 个元素、单次请求最多 2000 个元素，超限时本次不会写入任何元素

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The request body. The collection of elements to be written in this request. This parameter cannot be empty
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 请求体。本次要写入的元素集合，不能为空
v1_body_parameters.name: body

v1_parameters.help_en: The request body. The collection of elements to be written in this request. This parameter cannot be empty
v1_parameters.help_zh: 请求体。本次要写入的元素集合，不能为空
v1_parameters.name: body

Only uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-) are supported. If the model does not exist, a 404 error is returned
